audit.why: Yuumi has almost no lane pressure while detached and no hard CC or disengage against a landed Handshake, so Renata dictates every stage from level 1 through 2+ items.

Renata's Handshake all-in at level 2 and R flip in grouped 2+ item fights are the defining spikes; Yuumi has no equivalent spike since You and Me! (W) has no cooldown but also no counter-engage once she detaches.
